title: RatGTEx RNA-Seq Analysis Pipeline
author: Daniel Munro

steps.title: Generate STAR Index
steps.instruction: Generate the genome index for STAR 2.7.9a using the genome FASTA and GTF files.

substeps.instruction: Run STAR with --runMode genomeGenerate, specifying genomeDir, genomeFastaFiles, sjdbGTFfile, sjdbOverhang, and runThreadN.

steps.title: Extract Individual-Specific VCF
steps.instruction: Extract a VCF file for a specific individual to improve alignment accuracy.

substeps.instruction: Use bcftools view with -s {wildcards.rat_id}, --min-ac=1, -O z, and -o {output}.

steps.title: Align RNA-Seq Reads
steps.instruction: Align RNA-Seq reads for a sample using STAR 2.7.9a.

substeps.instruction: Run STAR with --runMode alignReads, --runThreadN, --genomeDir, --readFilesIn, --readFilesCommand zcat, --twopassMode Basic, and --varVCFfile.

steps.title: Extract Exon Regions
steps.instruction: Extract all exon regions from gene annotations in the GTF file.

substeps.instruction: Use grep -v '^#' to remove headers, awk '$3=="exon"' to filter for exons, and cut -f1,4,5 to select columns, then gzip the output.

steps.title: Subset Genotypes to Exon SNPs
steps.instruction: Filter genotypes to include only exon SNPs with specific quality thresholds.

substeps.instruction: Use bcftools view with --regions-file {input.regions}.
Filter for SNPs with MAF >= 0.2 (minor) and < 10% missing values using -i 'F_MISSING'.
Index the resulting VCF using tabix -p vcf.

steps.title: Count Allele Reads
steps.instruction: Count reads with REF vs. ALT alleles in a sample for each SNP using gatk ASEReadCounter.

substeps.instruction: Set --min-depth-of-non-filtered-base to 10, --min-mapping-quality to 250, and --min-base-quality to 15.

steps.title: Perform Genotype Similarity QC
steps.instruction: Identify sample mixups by comparing RNA-Seq allele counts to genotype data.

substeps.instruction: Run qc_rna_to_geno_similarity.py to produce a similarity matrix and summary table based on the formula: mean(1 - abs(RNA_frac - geno_frac)).
For samples without a match, run qc_rna_to_geno_all_rats.py to compare test SNPs against all 6000+ available rat genotypes, including a known matching sample as a positive control.

steps.title: Resolve Sample Mismatches
steps.instruction: Examine QC outputs to relabel or remove samples.

substeps.instruction: To relabel: Edit the ID in the 2nd column of fastq_map.txt for all associated FASTQ files and regenerate the BAM file using the correct VCF.
To remove: Delete the ID from rat_ids.txt and delete the associated BAM and generated files.
If a match is found outside the current dataset, add the new genotypes to the VCF, unless the SNPs differ greatly, in which case remove the sample.

steps.title: Generate RSEM Index
steps.instruction: Prepare the RSEM reference using the FASTA and GTF files.

substeps.instruction: Run rsem-prepare-reference with the specified FASTA, reference directory, --gtf, and --num-threads.

steps.title: Quantify Gene Expression
steps.instruction: Quantify expression from BAM files using RSEM.

substeps.instruction: Run rsem-calculate-expression with --paired_end_flag, --num-threads, --quiet, --estimate-rspd, --no-bam-output, and --alignments.
Gzip the resulting .genes.results file.

steps.title: Collapse Gene Annotations
steps.instruction: Combine all isoforms of a gene into a single transcript using collapse_annotation.py.

substeps.instruction: Run python3 src/collapse_annotation.py using the GTF and genes.gtf files.

steps.title: Assemble Expression Tables
steps.instruction: Combine RSEM output from all samples into log-count and TPM expression tables.

substeps.instruction: Run python3 src/assemble_expression.py to generate log2, tpm, and iqn (including filtered) tables.
Compress outputs using bgzip and index them using tabix.

steps.title: Convert VCF to Plink Format
steps.instruction: Filter SNPs for sufficient variation and convert VCF to Plink binary format.

substeps.instruction: Run plink2 --make-bed with --vcf, --keep {input.samples}, --maf 0.01, --mac 2, and --max-alleles 2.

steps.title: Prune Genotypes for PCs
steps.instruction: Prune genotypes to remove linkage disequilibrium for computing covariate PCs.

substeps.instruction: Run plink2 with --geno 0.05, --maf 0.05, and --indep-pairwise 200 100 0.1.
Extract the pruned SNPs using --extract {params.pruned_prefix}.prune.in and export to VCF using --export vcf bgz id-paste=iid.

steps.title: Compute Covariate PCs
steps.instruction: Compute genotype and expression Principal Components (PCs) and combine them into a covariates table.

substeps.instruction: Run Rscript src/covariates.R using the VCF, BED file, n=5 for genotype PCs, and n=20 for expression PCs.

steps.title: Map cis-eQTLs
steps.instruction: Identify multiple conditionally independent cis-eQTLs per gene using stepwise regression.

substeps.instruction: Run python3 src/run_tensorqtl.py with --covariates, --cis_output, and --mode cis_independent.
Run python3 -m tensorqtl with --covariates, --output_dir, --output_text, --batch_size 10000, and --mode trans.

steps.title: Extract Significant cis-eQTLs
steps.instruction: Extract significant cis SNP-gene pairs and p-values.

substeps.instruction: Run python3 src/tensorqtl_all_signif.py to extract significant pairs.
Run python3 src/tensorqtl_all_cis_pvals.py to extract p-values for all tested cis-window SNPs per gene.

steps.title: Calculate Allelic Fold Change
steps.instruction: Calculate the effect size (allelic fold change) for the top association per gene and all significant cis-eQTLs.

substeps.instruction: Run python3 tools/aFC/aFC.py using the VCF and phenotype BED file.

description: Map cis-eQTLs, determining significance using permutations. Outputs the top association per gene. This script calls tensorQTL and uses the random_tiebreak parameter, which is important for outbred populations in which there are often multiple top eSNPs in 100% LD. Without the random tiebreak, the first or last tied top SNP is returned, resulting in positional bias. tensorQTL run_tensorqtl.py python3 src/run_tensorqtl.py \ {params.geno_prefix} \ {input.bed} \ {output} \ --covariates {input.covar} \ --mode cis Get summary statistics for all tested cis-window SNPs per gene. tensorQTL tensorqtl cis_nominal python3 -m tensorqtl \ {params.geno_prefix} \ {input.bed} \ {wildcards.tissue} \ --covariates {input.covar} \ --output_dir {params.outdir} \ --mode cis_nominal
